tools.cmd: a=; [ x$apply = x1 ] && a=--apply; td=7; [ x$toolout_days != x ] && td=$toolout_days; sd=30; [ x$scan_days != x ] && sd=$scan_days; /system/bin/timeout 45 /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/bin/python3 /data/lemonbrain/maintenance/log_rotate.py $a --toolout-days $td --scan-days $sd
tools.params: apply:string:1=实际执行,默认dry-run|toolout_days:string:toolout保留天数,默认7|scan_days:string:扫描记录保留天数,默认30

tools.name: magisk_boot_backup
tools.desc: [面具/安全] 备份boot镜像到六号仓库(带md5)
tools.cmd: test -e $img || { echo NO_SUCH_IMAGE $img; exit 1; }; BK=/data/小柠檬资源/小柠檬仓库中心/六号备份仓库/boot备份_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S); mkdir -p $BK; cp -p $img $BK/; cd $BK; md5sum $(basename $img) > $(basename $img).md5; echo BACKED_UP; ls -la $BK

tools.name: magisk_denylist
tools.cmd: M=/data/adb/magisk/magisk; case $action in add) $M --denylist add $pkg $proc 2>&1;; rm) $M --denylist rm $pkg $proc 2>&1;; *) $M --denylist $action 2>&1;; esac | head -80

tools.name: magisk_denylist_ls
tools.cmd: M=/data/adb/magisk/magisk; echo status=$($M --denylist status 2>&1); echo '--- list ---'; $M --denylist ls 2>&1 | head -100

tools.name: magisk_module_list
tools.desc: [面具] 模块清单+启停状态
tools.cmd: cd /data/adb/modules && for n in */; do n=${n%/}; [ -d $n ] || continue; s=on; [ -f $n/disable ] && s=off; [ -f $n/remove ] && s=remove; v=$(grep -m1 ^version= $n/module.prop 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2); echo $n [$s] $v; done

tools.name: magisk_module_toggle
tools.cmd: D=/data/adb/modules/$module; [ -d "$D" ] || { echo NO_SUCH_MODULE $module; exit 1; }; if [ $state = off ]; then touch $D/disable; echo DISABLED $module; elif [ $state = on ]; then rm -f $D/disable; echo ENABLED $module; else echo STATE_MUST_BE_on_or_off; exit 1; fi; ls $D/disable 2>/dev/null && echo now=off || echo now=on

tools.name: magisk_prop_get
tools.desc: [面具] resetprop读属性,key空则列全部

tools.name: magisk_status
tools.cmd: M=/data/adb/magisk/magisk; echo ver=$($M -c 2>&1); echo daemon=$($M -v 2>&1); echo code=$($M -V 2>&1); echo path=$($M --path 2>&1); echo whoami=$(whoami 2>&1)

tools.name: mem_curate
tools.desc: [自主神经] 记忆策展：标题相似度查重复候选+分库统计；L2只提议不自动改记忆

tools.name: mem_dirty_ratio
tools.cmd: [ -n $dirty ] && echo $dirty > /proc/sys/vm/dirty_ratio 2>&1; [ -n $bg ] && echo $bg > /proc/sys/vm/dirty_background_ratio 2>&1; echo -n 'dirty_ratio='; cat /proc/sys/vm/dirty_ratio; echo -n 'bg_ratio='; cat /proc/sys/vm/dirty_background_ratio; echo -n 'dirty_expire_ms='; cat /proc/sys/vm/dirty_expire_centisecs
tools.params: dirty:string:前台比例,留空只读|bg:string:后台比例,可空

tools.name: mem_min_free_kb
tools.desc: 查看/设置最小保留内存(vm.min_free_kbytes)

tools.name: mem_pressure

tools.params: query:string:检索问题|topk:string:返回条数,默认5

tools.name: net_sockets

tools.name: notif_list

tools.name: oplus_display_info

tools.name: oplus_frame_boost
tools.cmd: cat /proc/oplus_frame_boost 2>/dev/null; ls /proc/oplus_frame_boost/ 2>/dev/null; for f in /proc/oplus_frame_boost/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo -n "$(basename $f)="; cat $f; }; done 2>/dev/null | head -30

tools.name: oplus_mem_info
tools.cmd: ls /proc/oplus_mem/ 2>/dev/null; for f in /proc/oplus_mem/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo -n "$(basename $f)="; cat $f 2>/dev/null; }; done | head -40

tools.name: oplus_qos_info

tools.name: oplus_sched_info

tools.params: filter:string:过滤,可空|flag:string:如-s系统/-3第三方,可空

tools.cmd: [ -n $gov ] && echo $gov > /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuidle/current_governor 2>&1; echo -n 'cpuidle_gov='; cat /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpuidle/current_governor 2>/dev/null; echo '--- idle states ---'; ls /sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu0/cpuidle/ 2>/dev/null

tools.name: power_wakeup_toggle
tools.cmd: f_name="$name"; echo $state > /sys/devices/platform/*/power/wakeup 2>/dev/null; for f in /sys/class/wakeup/*/name; do if grep -q "${f_name:-.}" $f 2>/dev/null; then d=$(dirname $f); echo $state > $d/device/power/wakeup 2>/dev/null || echo $state > $d/power/wakeup 2>/dev/null; echo "toggled $d"; fi; done; echo '--- 当前 ---'; grep -i -- "${f_name:-.}" /sys/power/wakeup_sources 2>/dev/null | head

for r in /sys/class/remoteproc/remoteproc*; do n=$(basename $r); echo -n "$n name="; cat $r/name 2>/dev/null | tr -d '
'; echo -n ' state='; cat $r/state 2>/dev/null; done

for r in /sys/class/rfkill/rfkill*; do n=$(basename $r); echo -n "$n name="; cat $r/name 2>/dev/null | tr -d '

tools.name: selinux_avc_summary
tools.cmd: dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep 'avc:  denied' | tail -${lines:-2000} | sed -E 's/.*scontext=([^ ]+).*tcontext=([^ ]+).*tclass=([^ ]+).*/\1 -> \2 [\3]/' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -30

tools.name: xb_current
tools.desc: [X浏览器] 查看当前前台 Activity

tools.name: xb_download
tools.desc: [X浏览器] 下载文件到本地
tools.params: url:string:下载地址|out:string:保存路径(可空)

tools.name: xb_dump
tools.desc: [X浏览器] dump 当前界面 UI 树

tools.name: xb_fetch
tools.desc: [X浏览器] 抓网页HTML(绕开WebView限制)

tools.name: xb_open
tools.cmd: u='$url'; case $u in http*|file*) ;; *) u=https://$u ;; esac; am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "$u" 2>&1 | head -5; echo opened: $u

tools.name: xb_search
tools.cmd: am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "https://www.bing.com/search?q=$kw" 2>&1 | head -5; echo search: $kw

tools.name: yzt_dialect
tools.desc: [宇宙桥] 方言翻译(voicedic): lang=方言名(如闽南话) text=文本; 接口活着但language取值格式若报错需抓包宇宙工具箱确认

tools.name: yzt_iptv
tools.desc: [宇宙桥] 直播源清单: src=iptv(央视卫视CCTV等171频道)|livechina(国内直播), 全文落盘+频道数+预览

tools.name: yzt_movie
tools.desc: [宇宙桥] 影视搜索: sub=search src=kunyu77|bajie|ywhuilong kw=关键词 pg=页码; sub=playlist ids=剧集ID(注:上游源近期不稳,无响应会明确报错)

tools.name: yzt_netdisk
tools.desc: [宇宙桥] 网盘搜索(diskgirl): 探测get1.php跳转与最终页面URL

tools.name: yzt_res
tools.desc: [宇宙桥] 53at资源下载: file=backgroundColor|backgroundImage|updatelog(宇宙工具箱更新日志)|yellow|avatar(头像制作zip), 落盘+预览

tools.name: yzt_video
tools.desc: [宇宙桥] 随机短视频直链(302跳转拿直链): src=yujn(27分类)/yujnhttps/xjj(14目录)/xjj2/dj/cenguigui/hhl + cat=分类名(如COS/kawayi), 返回CDN直链
